visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen comparison shows a young woman with dark straight hair. On the left, she has neutral makeup; on the right, she has shimmering, cool-toned eye shadow and glitter. A small inset shows a male creator in a black t-shirt gesturing. The background is a plain, light grey studio wall with soft, even lighting. (2) The male creator is now the central figure, smiling broadly and speaking directly to the camera. He wears a black t-shirt and has styled dark hair. He holds up a black makeup brush, showing its flat, rounded tip. (3) A close-up shot of a hand swatching a shimmering light-blue powder on the forearm. Below, a makeup palette titled 'HUDA BEAUTY Rose Quartz' is held, with a finger pointing to a specific iridescent shade. The setting remains the clean, well-lit studio. (4) Close-up on the model's eye. A hand uses a small brush to apply the shimmering blue shadow to the center of her eyelid. The model's skin is smooth, and her lashes are dark and defined. (5) Another swatch on the arm, this time a pale, frosty purple. A single eyeshadow pot from 'SUQQU' is displayed. The hand then applies this light shade to the inner corner of the model's eye and along the tear duct area using a precision brush. (6) A hand swatches three different holographic glitter shades on the forearm. A 'shu uemura' palette is opened to show a selection of cool-toned shadows. The creator applies a greenish-silver shimmer to the model's lower lash line. (7) The creator holds a larger, fluffy black brush labeled 'K02'. He displays a 'DIOR' blush palette with four shades. He mixes the pink and light blue shades with the brush and applies it to the model's cheekbones in a sweeping motion. (8) A circular container of 'Slayfire Cosmetics' glitter gel is opened, revealing chunky iridescent flakes. The creator uses a small brush to place individual glitter pieces irregularly around the model's eyes, on the eyelids and temples. (9) Final comparison shots of the model's finished look with various close-up angles showing the sparkle and glow. The male creator returns to the screen, clapping and encouraging the audience with high energy.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male makeup artist/creator and 1 female makeup model.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male makeup artist with short styled dark hair, wearing a black crew-neck t-shirt. He has a friendly and energetic expression.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, solid light grey studio backdrop that provides a neutral setting for the makeup tutorial.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a cheerful male voice and an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic pop track featuring synth pads and a clean drum machine beat. He speaks with high energy and a bright tone. (2) A digital 'sparkle' SFX (high-pitched, shimmering chimes) triggers as a visual comparison occurs. The music remains steady. (3) The creator's voice continues at a fast, articulate pace, narrating the product selection. (4) A short 'whoosh' or 'pop' SFX accompanies a scene transition to the eyeshadow application. (5) The male voice remains dominant, exhibiting a professional yet excited instructional tone. The BGM maintains a consistent rhythmic drive. (6) Another 'sparkle' SFX is used when highlighting a new makeup product palette. (7) As the blush and glitter are applied, the narration remains continuous, with slight pitch variations to emphasize key words like '仙氣' (ethereal). (8) The video concludes with the creator's enthusiastic call to action, followed by a slight swell in the music volume before a quick hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Intro -> Step-by-step Tutorial -> Final Result -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate and teach a specific 'cool light' iridescent makeup style commonly worn by idols, while showcasing and recommending high-end beauty products and the creator's own brush line.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator identifies specific brands (Huda Beauty, SUQQU, shu uemura, DIOR, Slayfire Cosmetics) and his own brush line (KAI BEAUTY), showing their packaging and logos prominently.

high_inference.freeDescribe: Professional makeup tutorial with high production value, focusing on trendy 'Idol' aesthetic through the use of iridescent and glitter textures.
